fabricroadmap.summary: Data engineers encounter challenges when constructing metadata-driven workflows due to the need to establish multiple connections for diverse data source endpoints. Currently, existing connections lack the capability for dynamic referencing. To address this, we are introducing connections as a workspace item that will consolidate the connections Role Based Access Contro l(RBAC) with workspace. This feature will facilitate dynamic referencing in connections, thereby enhancing flexibility and efficiency in metadata-driven workflows.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflow Gen2 CI/CD
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 capabilities will be enhanced to support the following features in Fabric, including: Being able to include Dataflow Gen2 items in ALM deployment pipelines. Being able to leverage Dataflow Gen2 items with source control (Git integration) capabilities.These are highly requested capabilities from many customers, and we're excited to make them available as a Preview feature.

fabricroadmap.title: Azure Data Factory in Fabric
fabricroadmap.summary: Bring your existing Azure Data Factory (ADF) to your Fabric workspace! This is a new preview capability that allows you to connect to your existing ADF factories from your Fabric workspace.You will now be able to fully manage your ADF factories directly from the Fabric workspace UI! Once your ADF is linked to your Fabric workspace, you’ll be able to trigger, execute, and monitor your pipelines as you do in ADF but directly inside of Fabric.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Templates Gallery improvements
fabricroadmap.summary: Templates are crucial for customers to reduce their time-to-solution. We will simplify this with improvements to the pipeline template gallery including new templates for AI and Semantic Models and new template gallery categories.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - "Triggered By" information for Data Pipeline activities
fabricroadmap.summary: A current limitation is that we do not present users with the name of the artifact that produced an artifact execution, for example, when a Data Pipeline triggers the execution of a Dataflow Gen2 artifact. We will provide a TriggeredBy field to capture the origin of each item invocation for monitoring purposes.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Expression Builder debugging experience
fabricroadmap.summary: A very common customer pain point is in the Pipeline interactive debugging scenario where users need a way to get immediate feedback about their pipeline expressions. To address this, we will provide the ability to run and debug expressions in the Expression Builder experience.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Trigger Management Pane
fabricroadmap.summary: In order to improve the user experience of managing many triggers associated with their pipelines, we will provide a UI panel that allow for managing pipeline triggers.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Pipeline-powered Semantic Model Refresh experience
fabricroadmap.summary: We will improve the Data Pipeline experiences within Semantic Model Refresh Settings by incorporating a shortcut from the semantic model management screens in Fabric to allow citizen users to utilize pipelines for advanced schedule of their refreshes.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Workspace logs integration for Diagnostics
fabricroadmap.summary: We will enhance the Diagnostics experience for Apache Airflow jobs developers by surfacing logs in the Fabric Workspace Monitoring experience.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - AI-powered Modern Get Data
fabricroadmap.summary: Modern Get Data Integration with Copilot allows users to seamlessly discover, connect and transform data using Natural Language. Copilot will be able to understand user intent and connect them to the right data across Fabric and other recently used sources, as well as applying any necessary data transformations to get the data into the desired shape.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Oracle
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring support Oracle as General availability

fabricroadmap.title: Data pipeline support for SparkJobDefinition
fabricroadmap.summary: Now you can execute your Spark code, including JAR files, directly from a pipeline activity. Just point to your Spark code and the pipeline will execute the job on your Spark cluster in Fabric. This new activity enables exciting data workflow patterns that leverages the power of Fabric's Spark engine while including the Data Factory control flow and data flow capabilities in the same pipeline as your Spark Jobs.

fabricroadmap.title: Data pipeline support for Azure Databricks Jobs
fabricroadmap.summary: We are updating the Data Factory data pipelines Azure Databricks activities to now use the latest jobs API enabling exciting workflow capabilities like executing DLT jobs.

fabricroadmap.title: Data pipeline support for Azure HDInsight
fabricroadmap.summary: HDInsight is the Azure PaaS service for Hadoop that enables developers to build very powerful big data solutions in the cloud. The new HDI pipeline activity will enable HDInsights job activities inside of your Data Factory data pipelines similar to the existing funcationality that you've enhoyed for years in ADF and Synapse pipelines. We've now brought this capability directly into Fabric data pipelines.

fabricroadmap.title: Support for invoking cross-workspace data pipelines
fabricroadmap.summary: Invoke Pipelines activity update: We are enabling some new and exciting updates to the Invoke Pipeline activity. In response to overwhelming customer and community requests, we are enabling running data pipelines across workspaces. You will now be able to invoke pipelines from other workspaces that you have access to execute. This will enable very exciting data workflow patterns that can utilize collaboration from your data engineering and integration teams across workspaces and across functional teams.

fabricroadmap.title: dbt job - New dbt job support in Fabric
fabricroadmap.summary: dbt job introduces native authoring and operationalization of dbt workflows within Microsoft Fabric, eliminating the need for external orchestration tools. This feature enables customers to build, schedule, and manage dbt SQL transformations in Fabric Data Warehouse and external data wareshouses, streamlining data transformation processes and improving productivity.

fabricroadmap.title: Data pipeline support for Event-Driven Triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: A common use case for invoking Data Factory data pipelines is to trigger the pipeline upon file events like file arrival and file delete. For customers coming from ADF or Synapse to Fabric, using ADLS/Blog storage events is very common as a way to either signal for a new pipeline execution or to capture the names of the files created. Triggers in Fabric Data Factory leverage Fabric platform capabilities including EventStreams and Reflex triggers. Inside of the Fabric Data Factory pipeline design canvas, you will have a Trigger button that you can press to create a Reflex trigger for your pipel

fabricroadmap.title: Staging defaults for Dataflow Gen 2 Output destination
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 provides capabilities to ingest data from a wide range of data sources into the Fabric OneLake. Upon staging this data, it can be transformed at high-scale leveraging the High-Scale Dataflows Gen2 engine (based on Fabric Lakehouse/Warehouse SQL compute).The default behavior for Dataflows Gen2 is to stage data in OneLake to enable high-scale data transformations. While this works great for high-scale scenarios, it does not work as well for scenarios involving small amounts of data being ingested given that it introduces an extra hop (staging) for data before it is ultimately loade

fabricroadmap.title: Data Factory Git integration for data pipelines
fabricroadmap.summary: You can connect to your Git repository to develop data pipelines in a collaborative way. The integration of data pipelines with the Fabric platform's Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) capability enables version control, branching, commits, and pull requests.

fabricroadmap.title: Enhancements to output destinations in Dataflow Gen2 (query schema)
fabricroadmap.summary: We're enhancing the output destinations in Dataflow Gen2 with the following highly requested capabilities: Ability to handle query schema changes after configuring an output destination. Default destination settings to accelerate dataflows creation.To learn more, see [Dataflow Gen2 data destinations and managed settings](/fabric/data-factory/dataflow-gen2-data-destinations-and-managed-settings)

fabricroadmap.title: Incremental refresh support in Dataflow Gen2
fabricroadmap.summary: We're adding incremental refresh support in Dataflow Gen2. This feature enables you to incrementally extract data from data sources, apply Power Query transformations, and load into various output destinations.

fabricroadmap.title: Fast Copy support in Dataflow Gen2
fabricroadmap.summary: We're adding support for large-scale data ingestion directly within the Dataflow Gen2 experience, utilizing the pipelines Copy Activity capability. This supports sources such Azure SQL Databases, CSV, and Parquet files in Azure Data Lake Storage and Blob Storage.This enhancement significantly scales up the data processing capacity of Dataflow Gen2 providing high-scale ELT (Extract-Load-Transform) capabilities.

fabricroadmap.title: Cancel refresh support in Dataflow Gen2
fabricroadmap.summary: We're adding support to cancel ongoing Dataflow Gen2 refreshes from the workspace items view.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Default Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: Default output destination experiences within Dataflows Gen2 have brought a significant boost into the usability and productivity for Dataflow Gen2 Creators leveraging Output Destinations.We plan to evolve these capabilities (already in Preview) and make them generally available.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Output Destinations: OneLake Catalog Support
fabricroadmap.summary: OneLake Catalog provides a seamless experience to discover Fabric data artifacts, and to easily reconnect to recently used artifacts. We plan to integrate OneLake Catalog within the Output Data experiences, just like we currently have it in the Get Data experience.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Output Destinations: Recents Support
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to bring support for Recents to the Output Data experience, allowing users to easily reconnect to a recently used Output Destination, much like we have made available in the Get Data experience.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Semantic Model Refresh Activity
fabricroadmap.summary: The flexibility and control over worfklows that data pipelines provides for refreshing your semantic models in Fabric has proven to be extremely popular. We are super excited to announce the general availability of the Fabric Data Factory Data Pipeline activity for Semantic Model Refresh.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Refresh History including M engine statistics
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 CI/CD developers will benefit from richer Refresh History information including M Engine statistics (rows processed, duration, etc.)

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Modern Query Evaluation Service
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 (CI/CD) provides a Modern Query Evaluation Service, delivering highly efficient and performant execution of queries. This Modern Query Evaluation service is currently available as a Preview feature: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/data-factory/dataflow-gen2-modern-evaluator]As part of the planned enhancements, we will make this new capability Generally Available and enabled by default for new Dataflow Gen2 (CI/CD) items.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Design-time query sampling
fabricroadmap.summary: We will allow Dataflow Gen2 Creators to create a “snapshot” of their data and work “locally” with that data in their environment without querying the data source again in the authoring / design experience, significantly reducing the latency after each query evaluation step.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Output Destination: SharePoint CSV Files
fabricroadmap.summary: After cleaning and preparing data with Dataflow Gen 2, this feature allows to select SharePoint files as its data destination. This feature makes it easy to export transformed data into a CSV file and store it in Microsoft SharePoint to be made available to everyone with permission to the site.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Output Destination: SharePoint Excel Files
fabricroadmap.summary: Taking the ability to output data results to SharePoint Files to the next level, we plan to provide the ability to output to Excel (XLSX) file format. This brings additional capabilities such as partitioning (e.g. to multiple worksheets) and conditional data formatting that will ease data exploration and consumption for Citizen Users.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Open Mirroring: Starter Kits (Python SDK)
fabricroadmap.summary: We will launch Starter Kits allowing developers to easily get started with Open Mirroring. These starter kits will be easily discoverable and accessible in product.

fabricroadmap.title: Data source identity management (Managed Identity)
fabricroadmap.summary: This enables Managed identity to be configured at a workspace level. You can use the Fabric managed identities to connect to your data source securely.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Data source identity management (Azure Key Vault)
fabricroadmap.summary: Support for Azure Key Vault - You can store your keys and secrets in Azure Key Vault and connect to it. This way, you can manage your keys in a single place.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: Azure CosmosDB
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring provides a seamless no-ETL experience to integrate your existing Azure Cosmos DB data with the rest of your data in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your Azure Cosmos DB data directly into Fabric OneLake in near real-time, without any effect on the performance of your transactional workloads.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring for Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring provides a seamless no-ETL experience to integrate your existing Snowflake data with the rest of your data in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your Snowflake data directly into Fabric OneLake in near real-time, without any effect on the performance of your transactional workloads.

fabricroadmap.title: Copilot for Data Factory (Data pipeline)
fabricroadmap.summary: Copilot for Data Factory (Data pipeline) empowers customers to build data pipelines using natural language and provides troubleshooting guidance.

fabricroadmap.title: Improved email notifications for Refresh failures
fabricroadmap.summary: Email notifications allow Dataflow Gen2 creators to monitor the results (success/failure) of a dataflow’s refresh operation.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflows Gen2 Partitioned Compute
fabricroadmap.summary: Partitioned Compute is a capability of Dataflow Gen2 that enables parts of a dataflow to run in parallel, reducing the time to finish its evaluations.Partitioned compute targets scenarios where the Dataflow engine can efficiently fold operations that can partition the data source and process each partition in parallel. For example, in a scenario where you're connecting to multiple files stored in an Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, you can partition the list of files from your source, efficiently retrieve the partitioned list of files using query folding, use the combine files experience, and pro

fabricroadmap.title: New connectors for Copy Activity
fabricroadmap.summary: New connectors will be added for Copy activity to empower customer to ingest from the following sources, while leveraging data pipeline: Oracle, MySQL, Azure AI Search, Azure Files, Dynamics AX, Google BigQuery.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job simplifies the experience for customers who need to ingest data, without having to create a Dataflow or Data pipeline.Copy Job supports full and incremental copy from any data sources to any data destinations. [Sign-up for Private Preview now](https://aka.ms/copyjob/preview-signup-form).

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Support for Mapping Data Flow transformations in Dataflow Gen2
fabricroadmap.summary: Mapping Data Flow transformations are coming to Dataflow Gen2, bringing the proven, low‑code Spark-based transformation capabilities of Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse directly into Microsoft Fabric. With this enhancement, customers can author and run complex data transformations at scale using the same visual, code‑free experience they rely on today—now natively integrated into the Fabric Dataflow Gen2 experience.This capability unlocks the full power of Mapping Data Flows within Fabric, enabling advanced transformations that are optimized for large datasets and predictable performance.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - My Queries
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to make My Queries in Dataflow Gen2 generally available, enabling users to save commonly used Power Query transformations to a personal library and reuse them across multiple dataflows.Moving My Queries to GA means it is ready for production usage, with the reliability, consistency, and support required for standardizing data preparation at scale.Key benefits and scenarios: Reuse proven transformation logic—such as cleansing steps, business rules, or standard joins—without rebuilding queries from scratch Promote consistency and reduce duplication when building multiple dataflows agains

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Google BigQuery
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring for Google BigQuery enables customers to continuously replicate BigQuery data into Fabric OneLake, making it easier to use BigQuery data with Power BI, data engineering, data science, and AI experiences in Fabric. Customers can bring data from Google BigQuery into the Fabric analytics estate without maintaining separate ETL pipelines for common replication scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Destination: PostgreSQL
fabricroadmap.summary: We are introducing PostgreSQL as a new data destination for Dataflow Gen2, enabling customers to publish transformed data from Microsoft Fabric directly into PostgreSQL databases using Dataflow Gen2’s low‑code Power Query experience.This release expands Dataflow Gen2’s destination ecosystem to better support operational, analytical, and application integration scenarios, giving customers a simple and flexible way to operationalize Fabric‑based data transformations in PostgreSQL environments.Key benefits and scenarios: Publish curated outputs from Dataflow Gen2 directly into PostgreSQL database

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring for Azure SQL DB
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring provides a seamless no-ETL experience to integrate your existing Azure SQL DB data with the rest of your data in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your Azure SQL DB data directly into Fabric OneLake in near real-time, without any effect on the performance of your transactional workloads.[Learn more about Mirroring in Microsoft Fabric](/fabric/database/mirrored-database/overview)

fabricroadmap.title: Apache Airflow job: Build data pipelines powered by Apache Airflow
fabricroadmap.summary: Apache Airflow job (earlier referred to as Data workflows) are powered by Apache Airflow and offer an integrated Apache Airflow runtime environment, enabling you to author, execute, and schedule Python DAGs with ease.

fabricroadmap.title: Migration Tool - Fabric Migration Assistant for Data Factory
fabricroadmap.summary: Microsoft Fabric Data Factory is the next evolution of Data Factory and is the modern AI-enabled home for all Microsoft Data Analytics. With this built-in capability in ADF and Synapse, you can instantly turn your Data Factory pipelines into Fabric native pipelines.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Workspace Identity Support
fabricroadmap.summary: Apache Airflow jobs in Fabric provide the most effective and easy way to build DAG workflows using our built-in Python code editor. Now that we have enabled workpsace identity (WI) support for our Fabric providers, orchestrating Fabric jobs from Airflow is super easy.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Copy data from/to Fabric Event Stream
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will be able to work with real‑time data by using Copy jobs to move data from Fabric Event Streams to supported destinations, or to copy data from supported sources into Fabric Event Streams as a destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Auto-partitioning on large tables with Oracle, SAP Hana and Lakehouse table
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job Auto‑partitioning automatically splits large tables into parallel partitions when copying data from Oracle, SAP HANA, and Lakehouse tables, improving throughput, scalability, and overall copy performance for large‑scale ingestions.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Extended SCD Type 2 support to Fabric Warehouse and Synapse SQL
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job – Extended SCD Type 2 support enables automated historical data tracking when copying data to Fabric Warehouse, and Synapse SQL, preserving full change history for downstream analytics and auditing use cases.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Manage loads on the source and destination store
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job – It allows you to control parallel on table or objects copy concurrency to manage load on both the source and destination systems, helping protect source performance.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Performance: Disable V-Order Compression
fabricroadmap.summary: The option to disable V‑Order (VertiParquet) compression in Dataflow Gen2 will become generally available, giving customers greater control over performance and storage optimization trade‑offs for supported workloads and destinations.This capability enables advanced users to reduce processing overhead associated with V‑Order compression during writes, helping improve refresh throughput and lower write latency for large-scale or time-sensitive ingestion and transformation scenarios.With this release, organizations can better tune Dataflow Gen2 execution behavior to align with the performance re

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Dataflow Gen2 Refresh
fabricroadmap.summary: With Microsoft Fabric Apache Airflow Job, you can easily orchestrate your Fabric processes. Now with a built-in Microsoft provider to run Dataflow refreshes from your Airlfow DAG, you can easliy leverage Dataflows from your DAG.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Data Destination: AWS S3
fabricroadmap.summary: We are introducing Amazon S3 as a new data destination for Dataflow Gen2 in Preview, enabling customers to publish transformed data from Microsoft Fabric directly into Amazon S3 using Dataflow Gen2’s low‑code Power Query experience.This preview expands Dataflow Gen2’s destination ecosystem to better support multi‑cloud data architectures, making it easier for customers with existing AWS investments to integrate Fabric‑based transformations into their broader data lake and analytics environments.Key benefits and scenarios: Publish curated outputs from Dataflow Gen2 directly to Amazon S3 buckets

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - AI-powered Transforms
fabricroadmap.summary: We will introduce an initial set of AI-powered Transforms in Dataflow Gen2, and surface those transforms available in Fabric, including capabilities such as sentiment analysis, data classification, summarization, entity extraction, PII obfuscation, etc.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - AI-powered Explain Pipeline experience
fabricroadmap.summary: We have had common customer requests for years to summarize pipelines in an easy-to-understand explanation and with Copilot in Fabric, we are delivering on that feature. Copilot offers a clear and concise explanation of pipelines, making it highly beneficial for both maintaining and documenting them efficiently.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - AI-powered Error Assistant and Insight for Copy Job
fabricroadmap.summary: Copilot helps to troubleshoot Copy job error messages by providing clearer summary and actionable recommendations.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Performance: Disable V-Order Compression
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 will introduce a new preview capability that allows customers to disable V‑Order (VertiParquet) compression for supported workloads and destinations, giving advanced users greater control over execution behavior, performance characteristics, and cost trade‑offs.This capability is especially valuable for scenarios where write latency and refresh throughput are prioritized over downstream storage optimization. By disabling V‑Order compression, customers can reduce processing overhead during writes, helping accelerate refresh performance for large or time‑sensitive ingestion and tra

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job/Activity- Improve read performance for CSV format when source is a single large file
fabricroadmap.summary: Improve the read performance when reading a single large csv file in Copy job and Pipeline activities (Copy activity, Lookup activity, GetMetadata activity, Delete activity) by allowing multi-threads.

fabricroadmap.title: Connector - New connector in Copy Job and Pipeline activities (2H)
fabricroadmap.summary: New connectors are planned in Copy job, and Pipeline activities 1. SharePoint Online File (as source and destination)3. Google BigQuery (as destination)4. MySQL (as destination)5. PosgreSQL connector (as destination)

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - SQL Server 2022 and before
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring support SQL Server on-prem (2022 and before) as General availability

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - SQL Server 2025
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring support SQL Server on-prem 2025 as General availability

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Lakehouse Maintenance Activity
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Lakehouses are at the core of success of your cloud analytics with Microsoft Fabric. Now with Lakehouse Maintenance Activities in pipelines, you can automate common important administrative operations including optimize and vacuum.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Support added for schedule parameters
fabricroadmap.summary: Hyper-parametrization in Data Factory pipelines enables powerful reusable generic patterns and is very popular in Data Factory. Now with parameter support in schedules you can create schedules that have specific parameter values to create complex execution patterns.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication to Fabric Lakehouse table
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from supported CDC source store, and replicate them to the Fabric Lakehouse tables—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Support more file formats: ORC, Excel, Avro, XML
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job can be used to copy more file formats including ORC, Excel, Avro, XML.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Support Workspace Monitoring
fabricroadmap.summary: With Workspace Monitoring for Copy Job, you can collect and organize logs and metrics from all Copy Job runs in an Eventhouse database within your workspace. You can also query this database to gain insights into workspace usage and performance, including the performance of individual Copy Jobs.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from Google BigQuery
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from Google BigQuery, and replicate them to supported destination—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from Oracle
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from Oracle Database and replicate them to the destination—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from SAP via Datasphere
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from SAP via Datasphere and replicate them to the destination—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - SAP with ABAP add-on
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job for SAP with ABAP add-on enables organizations to bring SAP data into Microsoft Fabric using a Microsoft Data Integration ABAP Add-On installed on the SAP server. It extends Fabric’s built-in SAP connectors and supports copying tables, views, and CDS views from supported SAP systems with both full and incremental copy modes.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication to Oracle
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can use Copy job to automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from any supported CDC source store, and replicate them to the new destination stores including Oracle without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC replication with full history tracking (SCD2)
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job supports CDC-based replication with SCD2 patterns. It captures incremental changes including inserts, updates, and deletions from the source system using Change Data Capture (CDC) and applies them to the target table while preserving full historical records.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Copy table from user defined query
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job lets you copy tables based on a user-defined query, giving you flexibility to select and filter data before loading it into the target.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Tumbling Window Triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: In ADF & Synapse, tumbling window triggers are very popular mechanism by which you can automate your pipelines using non-overlapping time slices that you can manage and rerun. We are bringing this powerful scheduling technique to Fabric through "interval-based schedules" in the Fabric scheduler.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Copilot support to create Custom Columns
fabricroadmap.summary: Copilot in Dataflow Gen2 greatly helps Dataflow Creators to author new steps and queries. We will take this capability a step further, in order to provide the ability to generate Custom Column (M) expressions based on Natural Language user inputs.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Data Pipeline Tumbling Window Triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: Scheduling pipeline runs using time windows that are non-overlapping and can be "replayed" is a very important feature in pipelines that many ADF users have enjoyed using. We are super excited to bring this tumbling window feature to Data Pipeline scheduling in Fabric Data Factory.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Multiple schedules for Pipelines
fabricroadmap.summary: To support richer complex and effective workflow orchestration we will enable Data Pipeline developers to have multiple schedule definitions for a single pipeline.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - SSIS lift & shift in Fabric Data Factory
fabricroadmap.summary: Public Preview: Q1 2026

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Rename Data Pipelines as Pipelines in Fabric workspace Display Name
fabricroadmap.summary: General Availability: Q3 2025

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Support pipeline parameters in schedules
fabricroadmap.summary: Pipelines in Fabric Data Factory emphasize general re-use patterns and metadata driven methodologies. Now with support for pipeline parameters in schedules you can create multiple schedules per pipeline with different parameter values enabling incredibly powerful generic pipeline workflow patterns.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Set the "Run As" identity of the pipeline from the pipeline schedule
fabricroadmap.summary: When automating your Fabric Data Factory pipelines, you will greatly benefit from having the flexibility to set the identity (i.e. user, SPN, workspace identity) of the pipeine at the time of execution. With this feature, you can now set it easily from the scheduler API and scheduler UI.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Easily add a Fabric Notebook provider into your DAG code
fabricroadmap.summary: When building a Airflow DAG in Fabric using the Airflow Job, you can now easily call a Fabric Notebook inline using this new feature.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - SPN enabled for Airflow Job REST APIs
fabricroadmap.summary: When creating and managing DAGs using Fabric Airflow Job REST APIs it is best to use service IDs for authentication. With this new feature we now support SPN auth for Airflow APIs.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Workspace Monitoring to include Apache Airflow logs from Airflow Job
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Apache Airflow jobs provides a SaaS way to build Python-based Airflow DAGs in your Fabric workspace. With this new feature, you will now be able to easily view your runtime logs from Apache Airflow in the Fabric Workspace Monitoring view to build your own queries, reports, and dashboards.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipeline Copy Activity support for additional sources
fabricroadmap.summary: We are expanding support for more source connectors in Copy activity, enabling customers to seamlessly copy data from a wide range of sources, including Teradata, Spark, Azure databricks delta lake, HubSpot, Cassandra, Salesforce Service Cloud, Oracle (bundled) and more.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Auto-enable CDF on Delta table creation from Copy job
fabricroadmap.summary: Change Data Feed can be automatically enabled for Delta tables created by Copy job, allowing downstream workloads to directly leverage the Delta Change Data Feed to track all data changes.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Activator support for triggering Copy jobs
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Activator can trigger Copy job executions in a native way, allowing event‑driven scenarios without pipeline where a file landing in storage automatically initiates a Copy job.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from Salesforce
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job provides a Salesforce CDC connector, allowing you to capture row‑level inserts, updates, and deletes from Salesforce and replicate them to any supported destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from PostgreSQL
fabricroadmap.summary: With the PostgreSQL CDC connector in Copy job, you can capture inserts, updates, and deletes from PostgreSQL and copy them to any supported destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from MySQL
fabricroadmap.summary: With the MySQL CDC connector in Copy job, you can capture inserts, updates, and deletes from MySQL and copy them to any supported destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Support composite watermark columns for incremental copy
fabricroadmap.summary: Incremental copy from Copy job will support composite watermark columns for complex change detection, including scenarios where the maximum watermark is derived from multiple incremental columns such as LastCreateDateTime and LastModifiedDateTime together.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job/Activity - Improve read performance for Parquet format when source is a single large file
fabricroadmap.summary: Improve the read performance when reading a single large parquet file in Copy job and Pipeline activities (Copy activity, Lookup activity, GetMetadata activity, Delete activity) by allowing multi-threads.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - SAP Datasphere
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring delivers a no-ETL, near real-time integration of your SAP data into Microsoft Fabric. Using SAP Datasphere, you can continuously replicate data from SAP systems directly into Fabric OneLake without disrupting transactional performance. This approach ensures your SAP data seamlessly blends with the rest of your enterprise data in Fabric, enabling unified analytics and insights at scale.

fabricroadmap.title: Apache Airflow job: Build data pipelines powered by Apache Airflow
fabricroadmap.summary: The Apache Airflow job in Microsoft Fabric is now generally available, providing a fully integrated Apache Airflow runtime for developing, scheduling, and monitoring Python-based data workflows using Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).What's New:• Introducing Fabric runtime versioning for Apache Airflow job – This includes Fabric runtime version 1.0, which comes with Apache Airflow 2.10.4 and Python 3 as the default runtime.• Public API – APIs are now available to interact with Apache Airflow jobs for seamless management.• Git Integration & Deployment Pipeline support – Users can utilize their Git

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring for Azure SQL MI
fabricroadmap.summary: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire Azure SQL Managed Instance database in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your existing Azure SQL Managed Instance data directly into Fabric's OneLake. Inside Fabric, you can unlock powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and data sharing scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: SQL Server On-Prem
fabricroadmap.summary: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire SQL server on-prem database in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your existing SQL Server on-prem data directly into Fabric's OneLake. Inside Fabric, you can unlock powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and data sharing scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: SQL Server 2025
fabricroadmap.summary: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire SQL server 2025 database in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your existing SQL Server 2025 data directly into Fabric's OneLake. Inside Fabric, you can unlock powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and data sharing scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
fabricroadmap.summary: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your existing Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server data directly into Fabric's OneLake. Inside Fabric, you can unlock powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and data sharing scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring supporting databases behind firewall
fabricroadmap.summary: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire database in Microsoft Fabric. Using either the virtual network data gateway or the on-premises data gateway, you can now replicate data from database that are on-premise or behind a firewall. The data gateway facilitates secure connections to your source databases through a private endpoint or from a specific private network.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Open Mirroring Support for Delimited Text
fabricroadmap.summary: Open Mirroring support for delimited text (.txt, etc) via UI and our Open Mirroring APIs.

fabricroadmap.title: Security - Workspace Private Link
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2, Pipeline, Copy Job and Mirroring will all support Workspace Private Link as Generally Available capability.

fabricroadmap.title: Security - Workspace Data Exfiltration Protection (DEP)
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2, Pipeline, Copy Job will support Workspace DEP also reffered as "Outbound Access Protection".

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - VNet Gateway support
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can use VNet Gateway in production for Copy Activity in Data Pipelines. We shipped public preview of this capability at FabCon US (March 2025) and will deliver GA by end of September.

fabricroadmap.title: Gateways - Autoscaling gateway clusters for VNet Gateway
fabricroadmap.summary: For VNet data gateways, the fixed node setup can be inefficient during high-demand periods. To improve this, we're introducing auto-scaling, which dynamically adjusts the number of nodes based on demand.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Enhanced Connection Collaboration Model
fabricroadmap.summary: To enhance security, we aim to prevent the sharing of Microsoft account credentials across collaborators. The new connection-sharing model will encourage each collaborator to sign in with their own Microsoft account.

fabricroadmap.title: Connector - Snowflake Key-Pair Auth type
fabricroadmap.summary: We will enhance the Snowflake connector to support Snowflake's Key-Pair Authentication type.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Support Connections in code-first artifacts
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature enhances security by ensuring connections are reusable across artifacts, eliminating the need to store credentials in code. It promotes better credential management for users of notebooks, functions, and GraphQL artifacts.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Data source identity management (Azure Key Vault)
fabricroadmap.summary: Support for Azure Key Vault - You can store your keys and secrets in Azure Key Vault and connect to it. This way, you can manage your keys in a single place.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Browse SharePoint UX
fabricroadmap.summary: One of the biggest challenges over the years for Citizen Users in connecting to data stored in SharePoint (Files, Folders, Lists) has been to specify the right SharePoint URL to connect to. We’re planning to provide a “Browse SharePoint” UX, similar to the existing “Browse OneDrive” UX in product, that will allow customers to explore the SharePoint Sites available to them – This enhancement is planned to ship across Modern Get Data (for SharePoint Folder and SharePoint Lists) as well as Output Destinations (SharePoint output destination).

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Recents in Modern Get Data
fabricroadmap.summary: Support users to quickly reconnect to their recently used tables or raw data sources within the Modern Get Data experience, saving them from having to specify data source and connection details again.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen2 Parameterization
fabricroadmap.summary: Users are accustomed to running metadata-driven pipelines where they can inject variables or parameters into different activities of a pipeline and thus executing things in a more dynamic way: Create once, reuse multiple times.As part of this enhancement, we will make it such that dataflows executed via a Data Pipeline in Fabric can be provided with parameter values for their existing dataflow parameters.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - AI-powered Error Assistant for Pipeline: Summarize capability
fabricroadmap.summary: Debuggability and errors message improvements are top-of-mind for our users. We have delivered incredible improvements for explaining Pipeline error messages with clear actions and recommendations. We plan to expand this functionality tol summarize additional insights for multiple running errors and help users with suggested actions for common issues.

fabricroadmap.title: Connectors - New Data Connectors within Copy Job and Data Pipeline (Copy Activity)
fabricroadmap.summary: While we have made great progress in addressing the most critical connector gaps between ADF and Data Factory in Fabric, a few connectors remain. During 2025, we will get to 100% parity by delivering on the following connectors across Data Pipeline & Copy Job: Amazon RDS for Oracle Cassandra Google Ads HDFS Microsoft Access Spark Greenplum Presto Jira Hive HubSpot Impala IBM Netezza Square Shopify XeroAdditionally, we will introduce net new connectors for: Fabric CosmosDB (read-write) SharePoint Online File (read-only)

fabricroadmap.title: Connectors - Azure PostgreSQL Entra ID Authentication Support
fabricroadmap.summary: We are enhancing the Azure PostgreSQL connector to support Entra ID Authentication.

fabricroadmap.title: Connectors - Oracle Connector support without requiring a gateway
fabricroadmap.summary: Oracle connector supports cloud-based scenario by bundling the Oracle Data Provider NET driver and avoiding users having to use an On-premises data gateway for Cloud-only scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job -  Change Data Capture (CDC) capability GA with SQL estates
fabricroadmap.summary: The Change Data Capture (CDC) capability in Copy Job is generally available with Azure SQL DB, SQL Server and SQL MI

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - CDC based replication from Fabric Lakehouse table
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from Fabric Lakehouse tables and replicate them to the destination—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Truncation on destination for full initial load
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will have the option to truncate existing data at the destination before performing the initial full load from the source.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Incremental copy reset and reload
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will have the flexibility to perform incremental copies in a way to reset the incremental copy to reload a full snapshot in the next run.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Upsert support for additional destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will be able to upsert (insert and update) data to a broader range of destination stores, including Fabric Lakehouse table, Salesforce, Salesforce Service Cloud, Dataverse, Dynamics 365, Dynamics CRM, and Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines - Orchestrate Copy Job from Data Pipelines
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will be able to orchestrate Copy Job alongside other activities within a single, unified pipeline—enabling them to trigger downstream transformations into the silver layer or send notifications and emails upon completion of the data ingestion task.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Audit Column
fabricroadmap.summary: You can use Copy job to add audit-style system columns when moving data to your destination, improving data lineage and compliance. This feature provides row-level visibility into your destination data, showing when rows were moved and where they came from, enabling downstream data lineage tracking and compliance reporting across the entire stack.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - CDC-based replication into Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: Support CDC-based data replication from supported sources into Snowflake tables as destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: Azure SQL MI
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can replicate Azure SQL MI snapshot and change data into Fabric Onelake

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: Azure Databricks Catalog
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can replicate metadata and create shortcut with data from Azure Databricks Catalog into Fabric Onelake

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can replicate Azure PostgreSQL Flexible server snapshot and change data into Fabric Onelake

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: Dataverse
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirrored Dataverse is a native experience in Fabric which enables data professionals to securely access Dynamics 365 and Power Apps data in Dataverse from any Fabric workspace, and to combine all their business data with analytical data in Fabric OneLake. Mirrored Dataverse enables zero-copy, near real-time, secure access to Dataverse data with a few clicks without the need for complex data pipelines or third party integration tools.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - New Source: Google BigQuery
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can replicate Google BigQuery snapshot and change data into Fabric Onelake

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Support for on-prem data sources and data sources behind firewall
fabricroadmap.summary: Database Mirroring supports replicating data from on-prem data sources and data sources behind a firewall with On-premises data gateway and VNet data gateway

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Enabling Delta Change Feed
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring supports delta change feed that enables fine grain tracking of changes of delta tables to be consumed by downstream applications.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Support for replication of Views from Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring will support replicating views from source databases.

fabricroadmap.title: On-premises data gateway (OPDG) support added to data pipelines
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature enables data pipelines to use Fabric data gateways to access data that is on-premises and behind a virtual network. For users using self-hosted integration runtimes (SHIR), they'll be able to move to on-premises data gateways in Fabric.

fabricroadmap.title: Semantic Model Refresh Tables and Partitions
fabricroadmap.summary: Pipeline users are very excited about our very popular Semantic Model Refresh pipeline activity. A common ask has been to improve their ELT processing pipeline by refreshing specific tables and partitions in their models. We’ve now enabled this feature making the pipeline activity the most effective way to refresh you Fabric semantic models!

fabricroadmap.title: Fabric Data Factory Pipeline Import and Export
fabricroadmap.summary: As a Data Factory pipeline developer, you will often want to export your pipeline definition to share it with other developers or to reuse it in other workspaces. We’ve now added the capability to export and import your Data Factory pipelines from your Fabric workspace. This powerful feature will enable even more collaborative capabilities and will be invaluable when troubleshoot your pipelines with our support teams.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen2 CI/CD support
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 items will support CI/CD capabilities in Fabric, including source control (Git integration) as well as ALM Deployment Pipelines.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen2 Public APIs with SPN support
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 items will be supported via Fabric REST APIs with Service Principal authentication support.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen2 support for Fabric Workspace variables
fabricroadmap.summary: As part of enhancing the Dataflow Gen2 CI/CD capabilities, customers will be able to bind their Dataflow Gen2 items to Fabric workspace variables.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflow Gen2 Incremental Refresh
fabricroadmap.summary: At the end of September 2024, we released Dataflow Gen2 Incremental Refresh as a Public Preview feature. We will continue monitoring customer feedback and enhancing this feature leading up to its General Availability, planned for the end of Q1CY2025.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Incremental Refresh support for Lakehouse destination
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 Incremental Refresh optimizes dataflow execution in order to only retrieve the latest data changed in your dataflow's data sources, based on a datetime partition column. This ensures that data can be incrementally loaded into OneLake for downstream transformations or outputing to a dataflow output destination.As part of this enhancement, we will provide direct support for Incremental Refresh to output data directly into Fabric Lakehouse tables.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen2 Parameterization
fabricroadmap.summary: Users are accustomed to running metadata-driven pipelines where they can inject variables or parameters into different activities of a pipeline and thus executing things in a more dynamic way: Create once, reuse multiple times.As part of this enhancement, we will make it such that dataflows executed via a Data Pipeline in Fabric can be provided with parameter values for their existing dataflow parameters.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflow Gen2 support for Save As new item
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers often would like to recreate an existing dataflow as a new dataflow. Today, in order to accomplish this, they need to create the new Dataflow Gen2 item from scratch and copy-paste their existing queries, or leverage the Export/Import Power Query template capabilities. This, however, is not only inconvenient due to unnecessary steps, but it also does not carry over additional dataflow settings, such as Scheduled Refresh and other item properties (name, description, sensitivity label, etc.).As part of this enhancement, we will provide a quick ""Save As"" gesture wit

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflow Gen1 support for Save As Dataflow Gen2 new item
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers often would like to recreate an existing Dataflow Gen1 item as a new Dataflow Gen2 item. Today, in order to accomplish this, they need to create the new Dataflow Gen2 item from scratch and copy-paste their existing queries, or leverage the Export/Import Power Query template capabilities. This, however, is not only inconvenient due to unnecessary steps, but it also does not carry over additional dataflow settings, such as Scheduled Refresh and other item properties (name, description, sensitivity label, etc.).As part of this enhancement, we will provide a quick ""Save As&quo

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Incremental copy without users having to specify watermark columns
fabricroadmap.summary: We will introduce native CDC (Change Data Capture) capability in Copy Job for key connectors. This means incremental copy will automatically detect changes—no need for customers to specify incremental columns.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job in Data Factory elevates the data ingestion experience to a more streamlined and user-friendly process from any source to any destination. Now, copying your data is easier than ever before. Copy job supports various data delivery styles, including both batch copy and incremental copy, offering the flexibility to meet your specific needs.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job CI/CD support
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job items will support CI/CD capabilities in Fabric, including source control (Git integration) as well as ALM Deployment Pipelines.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job Public APIs support
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will be able to programmatically interact with Copy Job items in Fabric via the Fabric Public APIs, providing support for CRUDLE operations over Copy Job Items

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job support for additional sources
fabricroadmap.summary: We are expanding support for more source connectors in Copy Job, enabling customers to seamlessly copy data from a wide range of sources. At the same time, we will keep keep the simplified experience while offering diverse copy patterns, including both full copy and incremental copy.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Export Query Results in Power Query within Power BI Desktop
fabricroadmap.summary: “Export Query Results” in Power Query in Power BI Desktop will enable users to leverage Fabric Dataflows to power data transformations – providing scale, performance and access to all Fabric supported destinations, including Fabric data items (Lakehouse, Warehouse, SQL database, Eventhouse), Azure SQL Database, SharePoint Files and more.These accelerated experiences will help customers benefit from the High-Scale, Performance and Wide Reusability provided by Dataflow Gen2 in Fabric, while ensuring their existing workflows in Power BI Desktop are not disrupted, and provide a gradual on-ramp for

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipeline support for OneLake storage event triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: A popular mechanism used to invoke pipelines in Fabric Data Factory is using the file trigger. When file events (i.e. file arrival, file delete …) are detected against Blob store or ADLS Gen2, your Fabric Data Factory pipeline will be invoked. Now we have added OneLake file events to the trigger event types in Fabric.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipelines Public APIs SPN support
fabricroadmap.summary: To make the use of pipeline REST APIs in Fabric much easier and more secure, we will enable SPN (service principal) support for public APIs.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipeline support for Fabric Workspace variables
fabricroadmap.summary: When implementing CICD across your Fabric Data Factory pipeline environments, it is very important to update values from dev to test to prod,etc. By using variables inside of Fabric, you can replace values between environments and also share values across pipelines similar to ADF's global parameters.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Run Pipeline when dependencies are met
fabricroadmap.summary: A commonly used functionality in ADF is configuring a Pipeline to run when a set of dependencies are met. We are excited to bring this functionality to Data Pipelines in Data Factory in Fabric to continue enriching orchestration capabilities.

fabricroadmap.title: Azure Data Factory item
fabricroadmap.summary: We are super excited to announce the general availability of the Azure Data Factory item in Fabric. With this new capability, existing ADF users can quickly and easily make their data factories from Azure available to their Fabric workspace. Now you can manage, edit, and invoke your ADF pipelines directly from Fabric!

fabricroadmap.title: CICD support for Data Factory data pipelines GA
fabricroadmap.summary: Microsoft understands that in order for you to build a complete enterpise data analytics solution, your developers need to have a collaborative CICD environment. In Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, we are happy announce that we have made the CICD capability of data pipelines generally available.

fabricroadmap.title: Fast Copy support in Dataflow Gen2
fabricroadmap.summary: We're adding support for large-scale data ingestion directly within the Dataflow Gen2 experience, utilizing the pipelines Copy Activity capability. This enhancement significantly scales up the data processing capacity of Dataflow Gen2 providing high-scale ELT (Extract-Load-Transform) capabilities.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from Snowflake, and replicate them to the supported destinations—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Actions
fabricroadmap.summary: With pipeline Actions, you can now easily define a simple pipeline template that can be a single activity or multiple acitvities, without using the pipeline canvas. Simply tell Copilot what you want to achieve, answer a few configuration prompts, and then reuse your Actions in multiple pipelines or from other Fabric items like Data Activator or Functions.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Export Query Results in Power Query within Power BI Desktop
fabricroadmap.summary: “Export Query Results” in Power Query in Power BI Desktop enables users to leverage Fabric Dataflows to power data transformations – providing scale, performance and access to all Fabric supported destinations, including Fabric data items (Lakehouse, Warehouse, SQL database, Eventhouse), Azure SQL Database, SharePoint Files and more.These accelerated experiences will help customers benefit from the High-Scale, Performance and Wide Reusability provided by Dataflow Gen2 in Fabric, while ensuring their existing workflows in Power BI Desktop are not disrupted, and provide a gradual on-ramp for cus

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Diagnostics Download
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to make Diagnostics Download in Dataflow Gen2 generally available, providing a production‑ready way to capture and share detailed runtime diagnostics for dataflow executions.Moving this feature to GA means it is ready for production usage, with consistent behavior, reliability, and support suitable for business‑critical data pipelines.Key benefits and scenarios: Download run‑level diagnostic packages including execution details and runtime metadata Speed up troubleshooting, root‑cause analysis, and performance investigations Enable easier collaboration between data teams, administrator

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Performance Enhancements for Computed Entities to Lakehouse Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 will deliver targeted performance improvements for a common pattern where data is processed in a Staging Warehouse (compute) and written to a Lakehouse data destination, such as when persisting the output of Computed Entities.These enhancements optimize how transformed data is materialized from warehouse compute into the Lakehouse data destinations, reducing data movement overhead, lowering end‑to‑end refresh times, and improving throughput for large and complex pipelines. Customers benefit from faster data availability in the Lakehouse, more reliable refresh performance at scale

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Tenant Admin APIs for connections
fabricroadmap.summary: New tenant admin REST APIs for end-to-end visibility and lifecycle management of all cloud connections in Microsoft Fabric — list, get, delete, manage permissions/ take over.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Support for Apache Airflow 3.x
fabricroadmap.summary: Microsoft Fabric Apache Airflow Jobs provided the easiest and quickest way to build enterprise-ready DAGs without any infrastructure requirements. They are based on open-source Apache Airflow and we have now updated our support to version 3.3 of Apache Airflow.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Actions
fabricroadmap.summary: With pipeline actions, we are extending the reach and re-usability of pipelines in Fabric Data Factory. Now you can take portions of your complex pipelines, a single activity, or even your entire pipeline, and register it as a Fabric Action. That Fabric Action is now fully accessible via endpoints in other pipelines, Data Activator, or UDFs.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Pipeline Dependencies
fabricroadmap.summary: When automating pipeline execution across complex data ecosystems, it is very important to only invoke those pipelines when specific requirements have first been met. In Fabric Data Factory, we refer to these as "pipeine dependencies". With this new feature, you will be able to set independent rules for each pipeline that requires data presences, trigger status, and pipeline status as optional depedency parameters for your pipeline runs.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Simplified Upgrade Experience
fabricroadmap.summary: In order to gain productivity boosts with AI in Fabric Data Factory, you can now easily upgrade your existing ADF factories to Fabric in a super easy friction-free way. Previously we had multi-step processes that were run from button clicks in ADF. Now your existing ADF factories can be automatically bridged from Fabric trial capacities and then easily upgraded as-is to native Fabric pipelines and data flows.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Pipeline Dependencies
fabricroadmap.summary: When building workflows with pipelines in Fabric Data Factory, it is very important to express rules that allow you to tell the workflow engine which conditions must be met before invoking or continuing your logic. In pipelines in Data Factory, we are super happy to announce that we've brought this capability into Fabric. If you are a user of ADF and Synpase, this feature was previously available as "trigger dependencies" inside of tumbling window triggers. With the inclusion now of dependencies inside of Fabric pipelines in Data Factory, you can now easily move your ADF and Synapse

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Approvals Activity
fabricroadmap.summary: We've enabled a key new capability in Data Factory pipelines in Fabric that extends the use of pipelines beyond just data integration and ETL. Now you can create powerful business workflows with pipelines with our new approval activity that allows you to gate the execution of your pipeline by setting an approver.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Workspace Identity support for pipeline activities
fabricroadmap.summary: With support for Fabric Workspace Identity (WI), you can now use WI authentication in your pipeline activities. This enables secure and reliable authentication to run automated pipelines using secured identities.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Network Security
fabricroadmap.summary: Network security is critical to running an effective and secured Apache Airflow environment. We are excited to bring Vnet and Private Link support to Apache Airflow jobs in Fabric Data Factory.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - My Queries
fabricroadmap.summary: My Queries in Dataflow Gen2 will become available in Preview, enabling users to save commonly used Power Query transformations to a personal library and reuse them across multiple dataflows.This preview introduces a reuse‑first authoring model, making it easy to apply proven logic—such as data cleansing steps, business rules, or standard joins—without rebuilding queries from scratch.Key benefits and scenarios: Reuse common transformation logic across multiple Dataflow Gen2 artifacts to speed up authoring Reduce duplication and promote more consistent data preparation patterns Accelerate creati

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Performance: Optimized Writes from Staging Warehouse Compute to Lakehouse Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: The Optimized Lakehouse Writes capability for Dataflow Gen2 is now generally available, improving performance for a common pattern where data is processed using Staging Warehouse Compute and written to Lakehouse destinations, including scenarios such as persisting Computed Entity outputs.This enhancement reduces data movement overhead between Dataflow Gen2's Warehouse compute and Lakehouse data destinations, improving throughput and lowering end-to-end refresh times for large and complex dataflows. Customers benefit from faster data availability in their Lakehouses, more consistent refresh per

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dynamic Schema Support for Fabric Data Warehouse Destination
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflows Gen2 will expand support for Dynamic Schema mode when writing to Fabric Data Warehouse destinations, making it easier to handle evolving data without manual rework.With Dynamic Schema, Dataflow Gen2 can automatically adapt to changes in your query schema—such as added or modified columns—when publishing data to a warehouse. This removes the need to pre‑define and rigidly maintain table schemas as your data evolves.Why this matters: Faster iteration: Update transformations without blocking on schema alignment. Schema‑flexible pipelines: Land evolving datasets into a warehouse with les

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen1 → Gen2 Migration Wizard
fabricroadmap.summary: The Dataflow Gen1 → Gen2 Migration Wizard provides a guided, end‑to‑end experience to help customers upgrade existing Power BI Dataflows (Gen1) to Dataflow Gen2 in Microsoft Fabric with minimal effort.The wizard supports both single-item and bulk upgrades, allowing customers to migrate one dataflow or multiple dataflows within a workspace in a single flow. fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Dataflow Gen1 → Gen2 Migration Wizard
fabricroadmap.summary: The Dataflow Gen1 → Gen2 Migration Wizard will become Generally Available and production‑ready, providing a guided, end‑to‑end experience to help customers confidently upgrade existing Power BI Dataflows (Gen1) to Dataflow Gen2 in Microsoft Fabric.The wizard supports both single-item and bulk upgrades, enabling you to migrate one dataflow or multiple dataflows within a workspace through a single, streamlined flow. It is available for Dataflow Gen1 items in Premium workspaces and requires Fabric to be enabled for the upgraded Dataflow Gen2 items to run.Beyond upgrading the dataflow itself, the

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Send Email Action
fabricroadmap.summary: The Send Email action in Dataflow Gen2 enables data‑driven email notifications directly within a dataflow, allowing teams to send emails that reference and include query results produced during dataflow execution.Emails can dynamically incorporate snapshots of query evaluation results into the email body, as well as use query outputs as inputs to email parameters such as recipients, subject, importance, and message content. This makes it easy to deliver contextual, data‑backed notifications without post‑processing or custom scripting.The Send Email action can be triggered conditionally based o

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - SAP with ABAP add-on
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job for SAP with ABAP add-on enables organizations to bring SAP data into Microsoft Fabric using a Microsoft Data Integration ABAP Add-On installed on the SAP server. It extends Fabric’s built-in SAP connectors and supports copying tables, views, and CDS views from supported SAP systems with both full and incremental copy modes.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Incremental copy GA with new meter
fabricroadmap.summary: Incremental copy in Copy job will be GA with new meter.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Connector parity with pipeline  (batch + incremental)
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will use Copy job to copy data from/to the same number of data store type support by Copy activity in pipeline.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Variable library support for CICD
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will be able to customize the connection used in a Copy job, allowing them to point to different data stores across development, test, and production environments.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Open Mirroring: Parquet Support
fabricroadmap.summary: Targeting GA of Open Mirroring with Parquet Support along with Python SDKs.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Output Destination: CSV Files in Fabric Lakehouse
fabricroadmap.summary: We will support the ability to output dataflow query results into CSV Files stored in Fabric Lakehouses.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Output Destination:  Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: We continue enhancing the options for Dataflow Gen2 creators to output their transformation results to the destinations they need. Snowflake databases are the top non-MSFT requested destination, and we aim to provide the ability to output query results to new or existing tables in Snowflake databases.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Schema Support in Dataflow Gen2 Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: One of the most requested enhancements to the Output Destinations experience over relational databases is having the ability to create new tables within specific schemas. We plan to enable this over destinations such as Lakehouse, Warehouse and SQL databases.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Parameter Support in Dataflow Gen2 Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: Parameterized dataflows is a top area of customer feedback, and one of the most common use cases is to parameterize the Output Destination within a dataflow. We plan to support the ability to parameterize the container (database/artifact/folder), as well as the table within it to which the dataflow outputs data.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Merge/Upsert Support for Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: A commonly requested new capability for Output Destinations is the ability to merge, or upsert, data into previously loaded rows in the destination table. We aim to provide this support for Fabric Lakehouse destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Power Query - Modern Power Query Get Data in Power BI Desktop
fabricroadmap.summary: Modern Get Data offers highly intuitive methods for users to connect to their data from a wide range of data sources. By integrating Modern Get Data with Power BI Desktop, users will also be able to easily discover and consume data stored in Fabric via the OneLake Catalog which is now deeply integrated within the Modern Get Data experience. This Modern Get Data experience facilitates an efficient process for importing data into Power BI reports to enable self-service data analytics.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Workspace Identities support in Connections
fabricroadmap.summary: This enhancement to support workspace identities in Connections provides significant value by offering a more secure and flexible authentication method for accessing data resources. It avoids hardcoding credentials, simplifies management by eliminating the need to rotate secrets, ensures compliance with security policies, integrates seamlessly with Azure services, and supports scalability in connections by allowing multiple instances to share the same identity.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Output Destination: SharePoint CSV Files
fabricroadmap.summary: After cleaning and preparing data with Dataflow Gen 2, this feature allows to select SharePoint files as its data destination. This feature makes it easy to export transformed data into a CSV file and store it in Microsoft SharePoint to be made available to everyone with permission to the site.

fabricroadmap.title: Open Mirroring
fabricroadmap.summary: Open Mirroring, is a powerful feature that enhances Fabric’s extensibility by allowing any application or data provider to bring their data estate directly into OneLake with minimal effort. By enabling data providers and applications to write change data directly into a mirrored database within Fabric, Open Mirroring simplifies the handling of complex data changes, ensuring that all mirrored data is continuously up-to-date and ready for analysis.

fabricroadmap.title: Gateways - On-premises data gateway auto-update
fabricroadmap.summary: The on-premises data gateway auto-upgrade feature ensures that the gateway always runs the latest version, providing improved functionality, security updates, and new features without manual intervention. This feature simplifies the management of the gateway by automatically downloading and installing updates as they become available.

fabricroadmap.title: Data Pipeline support for VNET gateways
fabricroadmap.summary: VNET data gateway will support Fabric Data Pipeline including pipeline copy activity and other pipeline activities. Customers will be able to securely connect to their data sources in pipeline via VNET data gateway.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - VNET Gateway Support
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can use VNet Gateway in production for Copy Job artifacts. We shipped public preview of this capability at FabCon US (March 2025) and will deliver GA by end of September.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Enhanced and consistent experience across sources
fabricroadmap.summary: We will deliver an enhanced Mirrored Database configuration experience that is also consistent across all supported Mirrored Database sources.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Open Mirroring: Support for Non-Sequential Files
fabricroadmap.summary: Today in Open Mirroring we require users to upload their parquet and csv files in a sequence (000001.csv, 000002.csv, etc). We will add support for non-sequential files so customers have more flexibility when using the Open Mirroring API.

fabricroadmap.title: Fabric Data Factory Pipeline Triggers GA
fabricroadmap.summary: We are super excited to announce the general availability (GA) of pipeline triggers in Fabric Data Factory. Now that we've extended our capabilities to include OneLake file triggers to other existing trigger types like Blob store and workspace events, we are excited to see the amazing data pipeline patterns that you'll create using pipeline triggers as a GA feature in Fabric Data Factory!

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Execute Query (Streaming API)
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to make the Execute Query API generally available, enabling production‑ready, on‑demand execution of Power Query logic in Fabric.GA means the API is ready for business‑critical workloads, with stronger reliability, performance, and support expectations—so customers can confidently integrate it into automated and application‑driven scenarios.Key benefits and scenarios: Programmatically run Power Query transformations based on your custom triggering logic Enable event‑driven, near‑real‑time data pipelines and application‑triggered data prep Integrate Fabric transformations into orchestra

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Recent Tables
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to make Recent Tables in Dataflow Gen2 generally available, helping users quickly reconnect to tables they’ve used before and accelerate the Modern Get Data experience.Going GA means Recent Tables is ready for production usage, with the reliability, consistency, and support required for everyday and business‑critical data preparation workflows.Key benefits and scenarios: Quickly re‑access previously used tables without re‑browsing or re‑discovering sources Faster iteration when building or updating multiple dataflows that reuse familiar data A more efficient, streamlined Modern Get Dat

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New destination: Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to make the Snowflake Data Destination in Dataflow Gen2 generally available, enabling customers to publish curated, transformed data directly into Snowflake using Fabric’s low‑code data preparation experience.Moving this feature to GA means it is ready for production usage, with the reliability, consistency, and support expectations required for business‑critical workloads.Key benefits and scenarios: Publish standardized outputs from Dataflow Gen2 directly to Snowflake as part of governed Fabric workflows Support hybrid and multi‑cloud data architectures while keeping transformation lo

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New destination: Excel Workbooks (XLSX)
fabricroadmap.summary: We plan to make the Excel Workbook (XLSX) Data Destination in Dataflow Gen2 generally available, enabling customers to publish curated, refreshed data directly into Excel files using Fabric’s low‑code transformation experience.Taking this feature to GA means it is ready for production usage, with the reliability, consistency, and support required for operational and business‑critical workflows.Key benefits and scenarios: Write transformed outputs from Dataflow Gen2 directly to Excel workbooks for broad accessibility Enable business users to consume governed, regularly refreshed data in familia

fabricroadmap.title: Power Query - Sort Rows transformation dialog
fabricroadmap.summary: Power Query will introduce a new Sort Rows transformation dialog, delivering a clearer and more powerful experience for defining row ordering as part of data preparation.The new dialog makes it easy to sort data by one or multiple columns with explicit control over precedence and sort direction, all through a guided, visual interface.
